decisions.statement: A refresh that worked reads as ok.
A refresh that failed reads as terminal where the failure says the refresh is terminal.
A refresh that failed reads as retryable where the failure says that refresh is not terminal.
A refresh that is not terminal removes the terminal instant.
A refresh that is terminal marks the moment handed in as the terminal instant.
A moment no instant reads from marks nothing rather than a removal.
A window trigger marks the moment handed in.
An alert latch has the instant handed in rather than an instant read here.
A latch handed no instant is a removal.
A latch handed blank text is a removal.
A token is terminal only where the refresh is terminal and its access token has expired.
A token that is terminal and unalerted alerts.
A token that is terminal and already alerted alerts no second time.
A refresh that worked clears a latch that is there.
A token whose access token names no expiry is never terminal.
Every instant this module works from is handed in by the caller.
Nothing here says anything to a log.
